import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
X = train_df.drop(["target", "id"], axis=1)
y = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df.drop(["id"], axis=1)

# Identify feature types
continuous_cols = [
    col
    for col in X.columns
    if X[col].dtype in ["float64", "int64"] and col not in ["f_29", "f_30"]
]
categorical_int_cols = ["f_29", "f_30"]
string_col = "f_27"

# Encode string feature with ordinal encoding
oe = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown="use_encoded_value", unknown_value=-1)
X[string_col] = oe.fit_transform(X[[string_col]])
X_test[string_col] = oe.transform(X_test[[string_col]])

# One-hot encode low-cardinality integer features
ohe = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown="ignore")
X_ohe = ohe.fit_transform(X[categorical_int_cols])
X_test_ohe = ohe.transform(X_test[categorical_int_cols])

# Create polynomial features for continuous variables (degree=2, but limited features to avoid explosion)
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False)
X_poly = poly.fit_transform(X[continuous_cols])
X_test_poly = poly.transform(X_test[continuous_cols])

# Combine features
X_combined = np.hstack(
    [X[continuous_cols].values, X[string_col].values.reshape(-1, 1), X_ohe, X_poly]
)
X_test_combined = np.hstack(
    [
        X_test[continuous_cols].values,
        X_test[string_col].values.reshape(-1, 1),
        X_test_ohe,
        X_test_poly,
    ]
)

# Train-validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_combined, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Train LightGBM model
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 64,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data
final_train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_combined, label=y)
final_model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    final_train_data,
    num_boost_round=model.best_iteration,
    valid_sets=[final_train_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = final_model.predict(X_test_combined)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].values, "target": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
